mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
